description: Mechanism of action registry — pharmacologic class of a drug or drug-class cluster. Stable ids used as FKs from drugs.json and (optionally) from lexicon clusters that represent drug classes (e.g. glp_1, ace_arb).

items.label: Antimetabolite (IMPDH / purine inhibitor)
items.description: Inhibits nucleotide synthesis to suppress lymphocyte proliferation. Includes mycophenolate (IMPDH) and azathioprine (purine analog).

items.label: Alkylating agent
items.description: Crosslinks DNA, broadly immunosuppressive and cytotoxic. Includes cyclophosphamide.

items.label: Calcineurin inhibitor
items.description: Blocks T-cell activation via calcineurin/NFAT. Includes tacrolimus, cyclosporine, voclosporin.

items.label: Anti-BLyS / BAFF monoclonal antibody
items.description: Neutralizes B-cell activating factor (BLyS/BAFF) to reduce B-cell survival. Includes belimumab.

items.label: Corticosteroid
items.description: Glucocorticoid receptor agonist — broad anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressive. Includes prednisone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone.

items.label: Antimalarial (immunomodulator)
items.description: TLR / autophagy modulator used for autoimmune disease background therapy. Includes hydroxychloroquine, chloroquine.

items.label: Anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody
items.description: Depletes CD20+ B cells. Includes rituximab, obinutuzumab, ocrelizumab.

items.label: Type-I interferon receptor antagonist
items.description: Blocks IFNAR1, attenuating type-I interferon signaling. Includes anifrolumab.

items.label: GLP-1 receptor agonist
items.description: Activates GLP-1 receptors to promote insulin secretion, slow gastric emptying, and reduce appetite. Includes semaglutide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, orforglipron (oral).

items.label: Dual GLP-1 / GIP receptor agonist
items.description: Co-activates GLP-1 and GIP receptors. Includes tirzepatide.

items.label: Triple GLP-1 / GIP / glucagon receptor agonist
items.description: Co-activates GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors. Investigational; includes retatrutide.

items.label: Amylin analog
items.description: Mimics amylin to slow gastric emptying and reduce appetite. Includes pramlintide and the investigational long-acting cagrilintide.

items.label: Biguanide
items.description: Reduces hepatic glucose output; improves insulin sensitivity. Includes metformin.

items.label: Sympathomimetic appetite suppressant
items.description: Centrally acting sympathomimetic that suppresses appetite. Includes phentermine, diethylpropion.

items.label: ACE inhibitor / ARB (renin-angiotensin blocker)
items.description: Blocks renin-angiotensin signaling — ACE inhibitors block angiotensin II formation; ARBs block its receptor. Renoprotective via proteinuria reduction.
